items.quote: American Airlines Group Inc. (NASDAQ: AAL ) has pledged a $1 billion investment in the Miami International Airport to build a new three-level concourse D extension, facilitating larger aircraft.
which can accommodate larger aircraft and eliminate outside boarding, as well as boast 17 new gates
The revamped area will also be able to facilitate international travel in the future with direct access to the airport's customs hall, the statement said.
The project is set to break ground in 2027.
American Airlines recently recorded a dip in its stock price as rising crude oil prices proved to be a headwind for the flight operator.

items.quote: Jet fuel costs are one of the most volatile expenses for the airline as uncertainty over crude oil prices continues to loom amid rising tensions between Washington and Tehran.
